params.name: t3-kemeny-pullmajority-v1
params.convention: lower score = predicted better day_b rank; scores are PREDICTED
params.chosen_on: design data only (snapshot days <= 2026-11-17), see evals/claude/t3-movers/notes.md
params.prev_weight_note: Earlier days break exact day_a ties only. A day_a pull moves a pair's weighted margin by 0.5 or 0, an earlier pull by at most 0.5 * its weight; prev_cap 0.9 keeps the earlier total below 1, so a strict day_a majority always wins. 0.1 rather than 0.001 so an earlier-day margin beats the 1e-3 consensus tie-break in the Kemeny objective.

frozen.assert_guard: ok: history with day >= day_b raises AssertionError

models._rev_note: rev 11-16->11-17 is scored in the forward block with o30 models trained on 6->16.
